# REDIS_OPERATOR

The Redis operator's CRDs are registered, so Redis CRs have a type.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `redisOperator`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.redisOperator`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
